# EdelSenz

> EdelSenz is a South African technical ingredient and innovation partner — connecting global & local sourcing, functional formulation and finished-product manufacturing into one integrated solution. Majority female-owned, Level 1 B-BBEE contributor, founded 2025 by Yolande Schulz. 35+ years of combined FMCG experience, taking products from idea to shelf.

EdelSenz operates six specialised divisions, backed by one shared team of in-house capabilities (development chef, sensory panel, innovation kitchen & lab, product development, technical & regulatory, supply chain).

## Company

- [Homepage](https://edelsenz.com/): Overview of EdelSenz — story, divisions, capabilities, partnerships and contact.
- [Capabilities & Technologies](https://edelsenz.com/capabilities.html): Shared in-house capabilities and proprietary technologies (NutriSphere, Dairy Alt+, FibrePro, CompleteCore).
- [News & Insights](https://edelsenz.com/news.html): Weekly newsletter — food innovation, ingredient trends and EdelSenz news.

## Divisions

- [Global & Local Sourcing](https://edelsenz.com/division-global-local-sourcing.html): Speciality, not commodity — new, innovative ingredients and products sourced through trusted local and global networks.
- [Herbs, Spices & Seasonings](https://edelsenz.com/division-herbs-spices-seasonings.html): Sole South African distributor of Akay spice extracts and oleoresins, plus technical seasoning and custom flavour systems.
- [Milling & Baking](https://edelsenz.com/division-milling-baking.html): Heritage milling and modern bakery solutions, plus vitamin & mineral premix blends for fortification.
- [Personal Care](https://edelsenz.com/division-personal-care.html): Natural skincare, body and home ranges — formulated, sampled and manufactured under one roof.
- [Pantry & Home](https://edelsenz.com/division-pantry-home.html): Farm-to-shelf pantry ranges — pastas, sauces, preserves, granola, rusks, maize meal and single-farm ingredients.
- [Food & Beverage](https://edelsenz.com/division-food-beverage.html): Functional, trend-forward beverages built on proprietary nutrition technologies.
